title: Recording coverage by modality and synchronization pathway
method: Crosstab of pathway and modality; known reuse labels resolved from original event log.
meaning: Shows which alignment methods can support modern held-out versus legacy in-fit diagnostics.
limitation: File and method coverage is not itself proof of successful alignment.

title: Per-session HARP stimulus-transition timing precision
source: bonsai_event_log.csv/Frame corrected_timestamps; HARP photodiode.pkl analog transitions; pathway metadata
method: For each session uniquely match predicted and detected edges; histogram p95 absolute residual, including signed bias.
meaning: Left and right panels give session distributions with a one-frame visual reference.
limitation: Both are conditional on the existing alignment model; modern held-out predictions provide stronger evidence below.

title: BonVision→HARP prediction on withheld photodiode edges
source: Modern BV encoded transitions; original HARP photodiode detector; held-out edge interpolation from t03_session_sync.py
method: Withhold every fifth matched rise from interpolation; score predicted versus observed withheld rises.
meaning: Shows predictive precision and number of tests per session, labeling ambiguous periodic edge matches.
limitation: Matching association is still chosen upstream; low interpolation error cannot resolve a whole-period origin shift.

title: Proportion of predicted stimulus transitions detected within one frame
source: Corrected BonVision frame transitions versus HARP analog photodiode edges; estimated or assumed display frame reference
method: Absolute event residuals; each session supplies one fraction; only ≥75% matching-coverage sessions included.
meaning: Makes the sub-frame timing consistency claim quantitative without hiding unmatched events.
limitation: Frame values are estimated/assumed, not validated thresholds; fitted-model agreement is not an end-to-end T0.3 pass.

title: Event error in units of display frames: session-balanced CDF
source: Per-event matched corrected BonVision and HARP photodiode times; per-session event_frame_reference_ms
method: Compute per-session empirical CDF then average across sessions within each pathway.
meaning: At x=1, the y value is the mean fraction of matched events within one reference frame.
limitation: Each session has equal weight; matching selection and fitted correction remain non-independent.

title: Event detection precision versus systematic signed bias
source: BonVision corrected frame timestamps minus HARP photodiode analog rise/edge detections, grouped by method
method: Per session: signed median residual versus p95 absolute residual.
meaning: Distinguishes narrow-but-biased timing from both low-bias and low-dispersion alignment.
limitation: The corrected BonVision clock was calibrated using photodiode edges; these are conditional fit residuals.

title: Session-scale stability of stimulus-event timing
source: Matched corrected BonVision transitions and HARP photodiode edges across each recording
method: Median residual in final versus first quarter of each session; display distribution and dependence on event count.
meaning: Quantifies change in behavioral-event timing accuracy through the experiment.
limitation: Does not measure SLAP2 source-sample clock drift; discrete phase ambiguities can still exist.

title: Physical HARP photodiode transitions in the DI3 acquisition clock
source: Original HARP photodiode.pkl index and HARP_df.csv DI3 rising-edge times in the same declared time origin
method: For each measured HARP PD rise within the DI3 recording, subtract its nearest HARP DI3 rise.
meaning: Demonstrates hardware clock phase coverage at stimulus events, separated by imaging modality.
limitation: Nearest-edge phase is bounded by half the DI3 period and is NOT an end-to-end physiology timing error; index origin remains conditional.

title: Acquisition-event sampling resolution and DI3 interval jitter
source: Native index of HARP photodiode.pkl; digital rising edges from HARP_df.csv/DI3
method: Histogram of analog sampling intervals and p95 DI3 inter-rise interval deviation (acquisition-on intervals only).
meaning: Characterizes the measurement resolution and regularity of the physical HARP acquisition clock.
limitation: Analog sample interval alone is not PD detection bias; DI3 interval jitter does not prove source-line mapping.

title: Sub-frame fit consistency is not equivalent to independent T0.3 acceptance
source: Full registry, corrected BonVision↔HARP photodiode event results, independent source-clock evidence CSV if supplied
method: Left: event-fit residual below/above estimated one-frame reference. Right: independent imaging↔stimulus acceptance.
meaning: Makes clear exactly which claim the currently available metadata can support.
limitation: Independent PASS requires verified SLAP2 source line/DI3 clock association and verified frame period.

title: Stimulus timing consistency across recording campaigns
source: Registry session IDs; corrected BonVision event times; measured HARP analog photodiode edges; session frame reference
method: Connect per-session p95 absolute residuals in chronological acquisition order; lines are only visual guides.
meaning: Checks for systematic changes in alignment quality between sessions or acquisition campaigns.
limitation: No interpolation or smoothing. The vertical metric is behavioral fit consistency, not independently validated SLAP2 timing.

title: BonVision-to-HARP model coordinate offsets, shown separately from timing errors
source: analysis/qc/behavior/alignment_meta.json/intercept and slope in repository BV-to-HARP mapping
method: Plot saved affine clock-origin intercepts and slopes, preserving modern versus legacy pathway labels.
meaning: Documents offset and clock scale variation without confusing intercept with physiological latency.
limitation: Clock-origin parameters are coordinate conventions; piecewise models have additional warp parameters; absent reused metadata are missing.

title: Example recording: physical stimulus-event timing residuals
source: 863774_2026-08-04_08-12-47: corrected Bonsai event-log timestamps; HARP analog PD edges
method: One-to-one event matches; histogram of signed prediction-minus-detection residual.
meaning: Shows the signed lag and distribution of individual stimulus transitions for a real session.
limitation: Modern encoded PD samples were used to calibrate the same clock; legacy frames are model-fit checks.

title: Example recording: timing residuals throughout acquisition
source: 863774_2026-08-04_08-12-47: per-event corrected BonVision timestamps and detected HARP photodiode edges
method: Plot the signed residual of every matched event against corrected BonVision elapsed time.
meaning: Tests whether event timing remains accurate and stable through the recording.
limitation: Timing residuals are not a line-index-to-HARP drift measurement; dashed frame is a reference only.

title: Example recording: HARP stimulus events in SLAP2 acquisition-cycle time
source: 863774_2026-08-04_08-12-47: HARP analog photodiode.pkl and HARP_df.csv/DI3, unmodified acquisition indices
method: Subtract nearest DI3 rising-edge time from each HARP photodiode rising-edge time within recorded epochs.
meaning: Shows the phase at which each physical display transition occurred relative to the acquisition cycles.
limitation: Nearest-edge phase is not a synchronization error; same-clock index origin and per-DMD line mapping remain to be verified.

title: Actual stimulus event versus SLAP2 acquisition pulses in HARP time
method: Vertical tick marks locate unaltered HARP digital rising edges and analog photodiode rises over a 350-ms window.
meaning: Directly visualizes the acquisition-clock and stimulus-event relationship in HARP time.
limitation: Cannot show individual DMD source-sample times without a verified line-index-to-DI3 mapping.

title: Matched BonVision events and detected stimuli relative to HARP DI3 clock
source: Corrected bonsai_event_log.csv event times; HARP photodiode.pkl analog edges; original HARP_df.csv/DI3 rising edges
method: Use the photodiode index origin to put corrected BV events and observed HARP PD events on the DI3 clock; nearest-pulse phase and same-cycle fraction.
meaning: A direct event-level linkage across all three measured data streams, indicating where predicted and actual stimulus onsets occur in acquisition cycles.
limitation: Source-HARP common origin is conditional; closest DI3 cycle is NOT proven source frame/line time, and the p95 phase is not synchronization error.

title: Example recording: measured stimulus and corrected BonVision in DI3 cycle time
source: 863774_2026-08-04_08-12-47: corrected BonVision event times + physical HARP PD edges + DI3 cycle rises
method: For matched stimuli, compare nearest DI3 phase for each corrected BonVision prediction and each actual HARP photodiode event.
meaning: Displays whether event corrections place BonVision predictions at the same acquisition-cycle phase as the measured physical transitions.
limitation: Phase wraps are natural and not error. No inferred GIAnT frame_line_idx or legacy voltage sample time is shown without a validated physical anchor.

title: Supporting QC: source extraction line-coordinate and endpoint behavior
source: Voltage dendriticVoltageTraces HDF5 /traces/trial attrs and raw endpoint samples; GIAnT ExperimentSummary HDF5 Path*/frame_info/frame_line_idxs
method: Separate distributions of equal repeated voltage endpoints and nonincreasing GIAnT physical line-index steps.
meaning: Documents prevalence of source-processing timing conventions across sessions and modalities.
limitation: Neither finding alone determines absolute HARP↔SLAP2 timing error. Turn on SCAN_EXTRACTION to populate.
